models.name: todo_app_guestusers
models.description:
Guest user identities for conceptual tracking of unauthenticated visitors.

This table represents guest users at a conceptual level so that the system can attach future data (such as preferences or acceptance of terms) if business requirements expand. In the minimal version, guest users do not authenticate and do not own todos, but maintaining a normalized actor representation keeps the identity model symmetrical.

Each row corresponds to one logical guest identity that may be associated with browser or device context at the application layer. The table stores minimal profile and lifecycle fields only; all authentication and todo ownership is handled by member and admin users in other tables.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the guest user. Uniquely identifies a conceptual guest identity in the system.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name or nickname for the guest user. Used only for friendly identification in logs or future features; not used for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user record was created. Represents the first time this guest identity was recorded by the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user record was last updated. Updated whenever profile-related fields change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when this guest user was logically deleted. Null when the record is active; non-null when removed from normal use.

models.name: todo_app_memberusers
models.description:
Member user accounts for authenticated end users who own personal todo lists.

This table stores the primary identity records for regular users of the todoApp service. Each member user authenticates with a unique login identifier and password hash, and owns a private set of todos stored in {@link todo_app_todos}.

The table holds authentication credentials, account status, and lifecycle timestamps. Session state is modeled separately in {@link todo_app_memberuser_sessions}, enabling multiple concurrent sessions per user while keeping the account data normalized and independent from connection details.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the member user. Uniquely identifies an authenticated user within the todoApp service.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique login identifier for the member user, typically an email-style value. Used for authentication and communication; must be unique among member users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed representation of the member user password. The original password is never stored; backend logic enforces secure hashing algorithms.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional human-friendly display name for the member user. Used in UI or logs but not for authentication.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status for the member user. Typical values include active, inactive, disabled, or deleted; exact semantics are defined at application level.

plainFields.name: failed_login_count
plainFields.description: Counter of recent consecutive failed login attempts for this account. Used by authentication logic to apply temporary lockouts or additional checks.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last successful login for this member user. Null if the user has never logged in successfully.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this member user account was created. Represents registration time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this member user account record was last updated. Updated whenever profile or security-related fields change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when this member user account was logically deleted. Null while the account is considered active or recoverable.

models.name: todo_app_memberuser_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for member users, capturing connection context and session lifetime.

This table records individual login sessions for {@link todo_app_memberusers}. Each session row corresponds to one authenticated context, such as a browser or device login, and is used for audit and enforcement of session expiry.

The model follows the global session pattern: it stores only the minimal required fields (IP address, href, referrer, and temporal data) plus a foreign key to the owning member user. Business logic manages session tokens externally while this table provides persistence for tracing and analysis.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the member user session. Uniquely identifies an authenticated session instance.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_memberuser_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key referencing the owning member user account. {@link todo_app_memberusers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the member user established this session. Used for audit and basic security analysis.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL (including path) that the member user visited when creating this session. Captures entry point context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL reported by the client when the session was established. Helps understand navigation paths into the service.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created. Represents the time of successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session became invalid, either due to explicit logout or expiration. Null while the session is still active.

models.name: todo_app_adminusers
models.description:
Administrative user accounts with elevated privileges for operating and supervising the todoApp service.

This table stores identity records for admin users who can perform oversight on member accounts and todos. Admins authenticate similarly to member users but have separate credentials and status to support stricter controls and auditing.

Admin users may review or remove todos across users via other components such as {@link todo_app_admin_todo_actions}. Sessions for admins are tracked in {@link todo_app_adminuser_sessions}, allowing separation between account data and connection history.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the admin user. Uniquely identifies an administrative actor within the todoApp service.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique login identifier for the admin user, typically an email-style value distinct from member user addresses. Used for authentication and administrative communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed representation of the admin user password. Must follow strong security practices and never store raw passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional human-friendly display name for the admin user. Used in admin consoles and logs for easier recognition.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status of the admin user. Typical values include active, inactive, disabled, or deleted; application-level rules define allowed transitions.

plainFields.name: failed_login_count
plainFields.description: Counter of recent consecutive failed login attempts for this admin account. Supports rate limiting and temporary lockouts for security.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last successful login for this admin user. Null when the admin has never logged in successfully.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin user account was created. Represents the time the administrator identity was provisioned.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin account record was last updated. Updated on profile, credential, or status changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when this admin user account was logically deleted or deactivated. Null while the account is considered active or recoverable.

models.name: todo_app_adminuser_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for admin users, capturing connection context for oversight and security auditing.

This table stores session records for {@link todo_app_adminusers}. Each row represents one authenticated admin session, such as an active login in an operations console.

Following the global session pattern, the table contains only the minimal fields required to track who connected, from where, and when the session started and ended. This supports audit trails and detection of suspicious behavior without storing additional sensitive metadata in the session itself.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the admin user session. Uniquely identifies a single admin authentication session.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_adminuser_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key referencing the owning admin user account. {@link todo_app_adminusers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin user established this session. Used heavily for security monitoring and audit.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL that the admin user accessed when this session was created. Helps understand which admin interface entry point was used.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL reported by the client when the admin session was established. Useful for tracing navigation paths into admin areas.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin session was created. Represents the time of successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin session was terminated or expired. Null while the session remains active.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Core todo items owned by member users.

This model stores the minimal but complete representation of a todo in the todoApp service. Each row represents a single task that belongs to exactly one member user and can be created, viewed, updated, completed, reopened, and deleted according to the lifecycle rules.

The table captures required business fields including a short title, optional longer description, simple status (pending or completed), timestamps for creation and last update, and an optional completion timestamp. Logical deletion is modeled via a nullable deleted_at timestamp so that deleted todos disappear from normal lists while still being available for short-term retention and background cleanup.

Ownership is enforced by a foreign key to {@link todo_app_memberusers}. Admin users can read and administratively delete todos via higher-level operations, but they do not change the ownership relationship stored here.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the todo item. Generated as a UUID and uniquely identifies a single todo across the system.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_memberuser_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning member user. This links the todo to exactly one authenticated user account. {@link todo_app_memberusers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short textual title of the todo. Must be non-empty after trimming and is limited to a reasonable maximum length to keep lists readable.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer description providing additional details about the task. May be null or an empty string when the user does not provide extra information.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current business status of the todo. Expected values are "pending" for active items and "completed" for finished tasks, matching the lifecycle rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was first created. Used for ordering and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this todo, including content edits or status changes. Updated on each successful change.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was marked as completed. Null while the todo is still pending or has been reopened to an active state.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When null the todo is considered active or completed; when set the todo is treated as deleted and excluded from normal user listings.

models.name: todo_app_login_attempts
models.description:
Operational log of authentication attempts for todoApp users.

Stores each login attempt with its login identifier, outcome, and contextual information such as IP address and user agent. This table is used to enforce rate limits on failed logins, detect abuse patterns, and support security investigations.

Records may optionally link to a concrete member or admin account if the identifier matched an existing account at the time of the attempt. Successful and failed attempts are tracked with a result flag so operators can distinguish normal usage from suspicious behavior.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the login attempt record. Uniquely identifies each authentication attempt event.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_memberuser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the member user account associated with this login attempt. {@link todo_app_memberusers.id}. Present when the login identifier matched a member user at the time of the attempt.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_adminuser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the admin user account associated with this login attempt. {@link todo_app_adminusers.id}. Present when the login identifier matched an admin user at the time of the attempt.

plainFields.name: login_identifier
plainFields.description: Login identifier supplied by the client, such as email or username. Stored exactly as received after normalization rules so that patterns of failed attempts can be analyzed.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: High-level actor type that attempted the login. Typical values are guestUser, memberUser, or adminUser, determined after authentication logic evaluates the identifier.

plainFields.name: succeeded
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this login attempt successfully resulted in an authenticated session. True for valid credentials, false for invalid credentials or blocked accounts.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the login attempt originated. Used for abuse detection and incident investigation.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Optional user agent string reported by the client. Helps identify automated scripts and unusual client patterns in security reviews.

plainFields.name: failure_reason
plainFields.description: Optional high-level category describing why the login failed, such as invalid_credentials, account_locked, or rate_limited. Null for successful attempts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the login attempt was recorded. Used for rate limiting windows, trend analysis, and time-bounded security investigations.

models.name: todo_app_admin_todo_actions
models.description:
Audit log of administrative actions performed on todo items.

Captures when an admin user intervenes on a member user’s todo, such as deleting it for policy reasons or performing exceptional modifications. Each record stores the target todo, the acting admin, a high-level action type, and a reason category so that compliance and support teams can review historical decisions.

Entries are append-only and provide a durable trail of who changed what and when, without affecting the core todo lifecycle models.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the admin todo action log entry. Uniquely identifies each administrative action event.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_adminuser_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin user who performed this action. {@link todo_app_adminusers.id}. Identifies the responsible operator for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_memberuser_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member user who owns the affected todo. {@link todo_app_memberusers.id}. Used to analyze impact on a specific account.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the todo item that the admin acted upon. {@link todo_app_todos.id}. Enables reconstructing which item was removed or modified.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: High-level type of administrative action, such as delete_todo, hide_todo, or neutralize_content. Used for categorizing interventions in reports.

plainFields.name: reason_category
plainFields.description: High-level reason code explaining why this action was taken, for example policy_violation, legal_request, abuse_report, or operational_cleanup.

plainFields.name: reason_detail
plainFields.description: Optional free-form description with additional context about the action, written by the admin or system. Should avoid including sensitive personal data beyond what is necessary for audit.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Optional IP address from which the admin performed this action. Provides context for admin security reviews.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative action was recorded. Supports chronological audit and correlation with user-facing effects.

models.name: todo_app_rate_limit_events
models.description:
Operational log of rate limit triggers applied to requests in todoApp.

Records when the system enforces rate limiting for a specific actor, IP address, or logical key. This supports security monitoring, tuning of rate limits, and debugging of user complaints about temporary blocking.

Each entry includes the limiting key, actor context when known, the type of limit that was exceeded, and the time window for which the limit applies.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the rate limit event record. Uniquely identifies each enforcement event.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_memberuser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the member user associated with this rate limit event. {@link todo_app_memberusers.id}. Present when the limit is tied to an authenticated member user.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_adminuser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the admin user associated with this rate limit event. {@link todo_app_adminusers.id}. Present when the limit is tied to an authenticated admin user.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor type that triggered the rate limit, such as guestUser, memberUser, or adminUser. Used to differentiate protections per role.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Optional IP address to which this rate limit event applies. Useful for anonymous or guest-based rate limiting where no user account is present.

plainFields.name: limit_key
plainFields.description: Logical key used by the rate limiting subsystem, such as login_identifier, account_id, ip, or a specific endpoint group identifier. Enables grouping of events by limit dimension.

plainFields.name: limit_type
plainFields.description: Category of rate limit that was exceeded, for example auth_login, todo_write, admin_action, or global_client_limit.

plainFields.name: window_start
plainFields.description: Start timestamp of the rate limit window during which the threshold was exceeded. Combined with window_end to describe the enforced interval.

plainFields.name: window_end
plainFields.description: End timestamp of the rate limit window for this event. Indicates until when the client is expected to experience throttling for this key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the rate limit event was recorded. Used to order events and correlate with request logs.
